title: 落水啦
subject: eight friends on a Saturday junk boat and the one who will not get in the water until someone inflates her giant flamingo
caption: Cantonese moombahton pop sung by a four-girl group, the Dutch-house-meets-reggaeton club sound. A dembow kick and reggaeton snare in the boom-ch-boom-chk pattern; detuned Dutch-house synth stabs on the off-beats; a nylon-string Latin guitar plucking the riff in the verses; timbales and conga fills at the ends of phrases; brass stabs and an electric guitar doubling the accented chorus lines in the drop. Punchy and bright, dembow and bass forward, guitar and stabs wide, voices close. Four young female voices, half-spoken and confident in the verses, unison on the chorus hooks, short chanted counts sung live as written. 108 BPM, A minor. Sun-drunk and teasing on a hired boat. No four-on-the-floor kick, no trap hi-hat rolls, no Afrobeats shaker groove, no ballad bridge, no slow romantic reggaeton-pop, no autotune.
lyrics:
[Verse]
禮拜六 中環九號碼頭 集合
八個女仔 一架遊艇 兩箱啤酒
阿Mandy 戴住太陽眼鏡 戴住帽
仲帶埋一隻 未吹脹嘅火烈鳥

[Pre-Chorus]
船停喺牛尾海 個個除衫就跳
得佢一個 坐喺船頭 唔郁

[Chorus]
落水啦 落水啦 Mandy
佢話 火烈鳥未吹脹 我唔落
落水啦 落水啦 Mandy
一、二、三！ 嗌到成隻船都震

[Verse]
我哋輪流吹 吹到頭都暈
船家阿叔 攞個泵出嚟幫手
隻雀吹到 差唔多大過隻船
Mandy 戴好眼鏡 終於企起身

[Pre-Chorus]
佢行到船邊 擺好個pose
叫我哋影多十張 先至跳

[Chorus]
落水啦 落水啦 Mandy
影完十張 仲要揀相揀半個鐘
落水啦 落水啦 Mandy
一、二、三！ 佢終於跳落去

[Bridge]
撲通！ 水花濺到船家阿叔
火烈鳥 自己飄咗出去
Mandy 喺水度大叫 返嚟呀

[Chorus]
落水啦 落水啦 姊妹
而家輪到佢 求我哋落去追
游啦 游啦 八個女仔
一、二、三！ 追住隻雀游出公海

[Outro]
返到碼頭 個個曬到紅晒
隻火烈鳥 而家喺牛尾海 自己玩緊
